definitions.explanation: Describes something done perfectly or matching exactly as intended, with no problems or mistakes.

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}はばっちりだ。
{化粧|けしょう}がばっちり{決|き}まっている。
{今日|きょう}のプレゼン、ばっちりうまくいった。

notes:
USAGE:
ばっちり is an informal, expressive word conveying confidence that something is exactly right or will work out perfectly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ばっちり{決|き}まる: to look perfect, to be decided perfectly
- {準備|じゅんび}はばっちり: preparations are perfect
- ばっちりOK: totally okay
- ばっちり{合|あ}う: to fit perfectly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完璧|かんぺき}に: perfectly (more formal)
- きっちり: precisely, exactly
- ぴったり: exactly fitting
